title: The Psychology of Waiting, Explained
desc: Why can ten minutes at a bus stop feel like an hour, while ten minutes before seeing a friend fly by? Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through the psychology of waiting: the airport that fixed complaints by making people walk, the hidden rules of waiting lines, why not knowing is the hardest part, where is my bus, dread, fairness in queues, the people behind you, the lane next to you, the watched clock, being alone with your thoughts, why slower can feel better, waiting for news, the joy of anticipation, the marshmallow test and trust, why later feels smaller, almost there, and waiting for sleep. We end with the art of waiting well and a slow wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like.
